methods.label: Divide before adding
methods.explanation:
The mean is the total divided by \(9\). Each listed number is \(9\) times the number of the same length made entirely of ones. Factoring this \(9\) out of the total and then dividing by \(9\) gives
\[
M=1+11+111+\cdots+111111111.
\]
In this sum, the ones column contains nine ones, the tens column contains eight, and each successive column contains one fewer, ending with one in the hundred-millions column. No column total reaches \(10\), so there are no carries. Thus
\[
M=123456789.
\]
The missing digit is \(\boxed{0}\), choice \(\mathrm{A}\).
